title: keyval.cli.write/v1
description: The report of keyval put, delete, cas and resume (PLAN.md §8.7, O-4, O-6). Exit 0: result applied. Exit 1: a terminal result that is not a success (version_mismatch, capacity_exceeded, request_id_conflict, rejected, refused). Exit 3: unresolved, whose outcome is UNKNOWN, never failed; the pending record is kept and `resume` names the command that sends it again with the same ID and bytes.

result.description: applied: executed (a success). version_mismatch, capacity_exceeded, request_id_conflict: terminal results that changed nothing. rejected: refused as a bad request. refused: history_full with nothing submitted; it did not execute. unresolved: the bounds ran out; it may or may not have executed.

via_status_lookup.description: Whether a status lookup, not a resend, resolved the write.

rejection.description: The server refused the request itself; nothing executed and the same bytes would be refused again.

unresolved.description: Set only when a retry bound ran out without a terminal answer. For a write this is NOT a failure: it may have executed.

resume.description: The exact command that resumes the request, when there is something to resume.

pending_record_left.description: Set if the write is done but its pending record could not be deleted; resuming it replays it harmlessly (C-6).

notes.description: Things worth telling the person: unreachable nodes, unreadable answers. Bounded.
